page0.text:
"......"
His palm slams into me.
That doesn't change, no matter how my body has changed.
His attack, aimed at doing internal rather than external damage, ruthlessly sends shockwaves through me.

page1.text:
The battle is overwhelming.
The enemy dodges, repels, and traps my fists, all while making me eat all of his attacks.
Pure white mangles my vision every time Kotomine's fists clang off my body.

page2.text: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

page3.text:
"......"
I protect my head.
My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.
This could end with a single blow to my head.
I can't hit him with my fists, so I use both arms to protect my head.

page4.text:
My sense of pain is long gone, and my eyesight is about to blink out, too.
The pain transmitted to my brain comes only from the left arm's invasion of my body.
His bloody fists pulverize every square centimeter of my frame.
I work my left arm to try and repair it, and—

page5.text:
Everything goes white.
Images and memories become irreturnably white.

page6.text:
"......"
It hurts even to think now.
I sprout blades to protect my destroyed body from dying.
In exchange, my brain is shaved away.
Which of us will end first?

page7.text:
"Ngh... Guh, fuuhhh...!"
His fists and bones are broken.
He endures it, his face twisted in pain, and continues striking me.

page8.text:
"......"
I dodge the blows and attack with my right fist.
It gets blocked.
There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.

page9.text:
"......"
I can still...
I can still move. I can't move anymore. This. This is the l—

page11.text:
That hurt. That one got me.
My body shouldn't be able to feel pain anymore, but I nearly weep at the pain throughout my body.
I'm flung back, crashing into a fallen boulder, and barely stop myself from going over the cliff.

page13.text:
—.
Can't stand.
If the impact hurt this bad, the pain to my brain trying to remake my body would be unimaginable.

page14.text:
It's over.
In one more second, I'll give into the pain and burn out, and I won't be able to think anymore.
...If I sleep before then...
If I close my eyes, it...

page15.text:
"It's over. Now I'll crush your head."
The enemy walks over.
...He can't run anymore, either.
It wouldn't surprise me if we both disappeared one minute from now.
Then...I'm...

page16.text:
"Ah."
You swore an oath.
You swore to protect someone.

page17.text:
"Ah,"
Live.
She said that both of us were needed to save her.

page18.text:
"Ah, ah"
You lost something.
You lost something for that purpose.

page19.text:
"Ah, aahh..."
The enemy approaches.
He drags his feet toward me to crush my head.

page20.text:
Like hell!
I won't lose, this man doesn't have a goal, he's just living the only way he knows how...!
But I have it.
I have a goal.
I have a good reason to kick his ass and win!

page21.text:
"Ahh, ah...ah"
I don't know how long I made her cry.
—'s been crying in a place I don't know.
She always cried alone, and only ever smiled in front of me.

page22.text:
"Ah... oh"
...That's right.
So I have to protect her.
I'll protect — from the sins she committed, the sins blaming her, and the sins she remembers.

page23.text:
The girl who could only smile in front of me.
The girl who said she'd protect me, in a body with no future...

page24.text: I want to help her smile happily one day, even when I'm not around.

page25.text:
And you're in the way of that.
"Oh... Oohh, OH..."
Fuck off.
Sakura will never smile again as long as you're alive!

page27.text:
"Guh, nngh!?"
"Ah, aaaahhh!!!"
One blow.
The enemy comes to crush my head, and I punch his face with all my might.

page28.text:
"Ngh, damn you...!"
"Kirei Kotomine...!"
Two blows.
Three blows.
Four blows.
Five blows.
Six blows.
Seven blows...!

page29.text:
I punch, punch, punch, punch...!
This is the end, if I let him go there's no future, I need to put everything I have left into this miracle, this chance...!
"Ngh... AHHHH!!!"
I'm flung back.
He easily ducks my suicidal punch and makes me pay hard for it.

page30.text:
"Ah, gah, guh...!"
Damn it, that's right, he won't let me hit him that easily, and he's many times stronger than me...
So of course he'll parry my attacks effortlessly and come to finish me off!

page31.text:
"Hah... ah...!"
Yeah, so what!?
I can't overcome the difference in fighting strength.
Life isn't that easy.
The enemy knocks me to the ground and comes to crush my head.
I'll lose. I'll lose. I'll lose. I'll lose.
That much is self-evident.
But I can still move my body...!

page32.text:
"KOTOMI..."
The enemy's shadow looms over me, blocking my path.
And then, I take my disobedient legs—yeah, my right leg won't even budge—and ignite them into motion.

page33.text:
It's not going to end here.
I can't dodge the enemy's attack with these legs.
Death is a second away. I dodge it as best I can—

page34.text:
"...NE?"
The man in front of me stops,
his extended fist not quite reaching my face.

page35.text:
"...So this is how it ends. A simple difference in our remaining time."
He looks down at his own chest.
The dark stained area is where his heart should be.
...A different in time.
He must have started dying just slightly before me in the forest.

page36.text:
"You win, Shirou Emiya. I don't know how many more seconds your body will last, but hurry to your goal if you have one."
He's just like before, when I first met him in the church.
He talks about everything like it doesn't matter to him.

page37.text:
"...Kotomine."
"You are the final Master.
Go before the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish."

page38.text:
The final Master.
His words carry a profound weight, but he says them in his usual, unchanging tone.
Of course he does.
He'll never change, even in his last moments.
He's still my detestable enemy, even as he crumbles away.

page39.text:
"...Yeah. I'll destroy your wish. It's what I owe you for beating me to a pulp."
"—"

page40.text:
Did he laugh at the end?
My nearly scrap metal eyes are useless.
This time, the priest really does leave this awful world. No one mourns him.
